sections.text:
Frequent desire to take a long breath.
Feeling of weight on chest.

Aching in nape. Spine stiff and ach-
ing.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Adonidin is a cardiac tonic and
diuretic. Quarter to half grain daily, or two to five
grains of first decimal trit. Increases arterial pressure
and prolongs the diastole, favoring emptying engorged
veins.
